description: The Cases actions as typed sub-blocks, every attribute each type has: get_case find-case linking (link_contact_to_case "true", get_last_updated_case "false") with case_request_fields of the system field ids customer_id and status, case_response_fields holding a casefield reference key ("casefield:priority") beside the system field ids case_id and status, and its ContactNotLinked, MultipleFound and NoneFound branches before the catch-all; get_case find-latest not linking, with customer_id (the optional CustomerId) a JSONPath, get_last_updated_case "true", no search fields, case_response_fields of case_id alone, and the two lookups before the catch-all; update_case with case_id a JSONPath and case_request_fields holding a casefield reference key beside the system field id summary, linking the current contact (contact_to_link) with ContactNotLinked before the catch-all; create_case open-case with case_template_id a casetemplate reference key, case_request_fields holding a casefield reference key beside the system field ids customer_id, summary and title, linking the current contact with ContactNotLinked before the catch-all; and create_case log-case not linking, with a second template and case_request_fields holding a casefield reference key beside the system field id status, and the catch-all alone. The templates and fields are bound in refs to awscc_connectcases resources (hashicorp/aws has none). Awaits the provider release that carries these blocks and the reference key rule (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
